rationale: The workflow already applies path-based change filtering (only runs when deployments/kubernetes/chart/reloader/** changes) and label-based gating for the version-validation job, so it is already change-aware. The only evidence-supported caching pattern (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) requires a dependency-installation step with a lockfile/environment key (e.g., go mod download with go.mod/go.sum or npm ci), but this Helm workflow has no such dependency install step; it only sets up pinned tools via actions (checkout, setup-helm, helm-unittest, yq, check-semver) and runs checks. The repository's go.mod/go.sum are not used by this workflow, so caching Go modules would be unrelated. No matrix exists for fail-fast, no scheduled runs exist for fail-schedule/idle-schedule suppression, and no repeated-dependency fetch with a lockfile is present to cache. Adding a cache without a lockfile key or an install step would not be evidence-supported and could introduce unrelated changes.
